_README: Declared, reviewed truth about the Tier C canonical corpora. Two entries, because measurement
showed only two are needed: no Tier C command requires NIBRS (decision 5.5).
expected_schema_fingerprint is REVIEWED MATERIAL and lives here rather than in a snapshot
manifest. Comparing a database against a fingerprint recorded during its own acquisition is
circular: it restates the file hash and cannot reject a wrong schema.
Both entries are bootstrap_pending. The fingerprints below are NOT filled in from the first
database that happened to be observed -- doing that would manufacture an expectation out of the
thing being checked and call it independent knowledge. Observed fingerprints are reported for
review; once approved they are committed here, and only then can a corpus verify.
While bootstrap_pending is true, verification yields corpus_unidentified. That is the honest
state, not a reason to leave the field permissive.
row_floors are REJECTION THRESHOLDS for a truncated or wrong-shaped database, deliberately well
below observed counts. They describe nothing and carry no authority as a measure of the corpus.

corpora.forbidden_remote_reason: docs/query-audit-2026-06-10-codex-fixes.md:96 records /opt/nibrs/app/crime_data.db as the stale path that caused a divergence; production reads /opt/nibrs/shared/crime_data.db under the release-based layout. ecosystem.config.js:10 is the baseline.
corpora.required_tables_evidence: measured by uncapped SQL observation of all ten Tier C commands; 12 of the corpus's 17 tables. sqlite_master excluded as schema introspection. sample_agencies, state_monthly, national_monthly, sqlite_stat1 and source_build_receipts are touched by no Tier C command.

PROVISIONAL. Measured against SHR-Dashboard/data/shr.db, used for observation only and explicitly NOT adopted (decision 5.1). Must be re-measured against the authoritative snapshot of production /opt/nibrs/shr.db.
corpora.schema_discrepancy_note: The committed shr.ddl.sql declares agency_county_crosswalk; the observation-only database does not contain it. Whether production's shr.db contains it is UNKNOWN and is not guessed. The authoritative snapshot's fingerprint answers it. If absent there too, that is a DDL-versus-production finding to report, not a table to create.
